channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Creek Park, east reach
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Creek Park, east reach (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park, east reach: Two records were both titled Mission Creek Park (the…
item.description: Two records were both titled Mission Creek Park (the second page address ended in -2). The first is the park SF Rec and Park lists as Mission Creek Park (North and South); this one is the stretch between the Mission Creek Park Pavilion and the 4th Street bridge. No source names that stretch separately, so the name is descriptive and the record's open question about which OCII parcel label (P1 or P3) applies is unchanged. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks, facility page (https://sfrecpark.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Mission-Creek-Park-North-and-South-449) and Mission Creek Park South Extension Project page (https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje), Background: "including Mission Creek Park (North and South)".

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park, east reach: OCII's timeline gives 2002 for the opening of…
item.description: OCII's timeline gives 2002 for the opening of "Mission Creek P1"; whether this traced stretch is that P1 is not confirmed, and no source read dates this stretch itself. A landscape architect's page describes "Mission Creek Park North" (client Catellus, timeline 1999-2011, built), a project timeline rather than an opening date. Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf; https://mflastudio.com/mission-creek-park-north; https://sfrecpark.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Mission-Creek-Park-North-and-South-449.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park, east reach: The October 10, 2026 note about this change said the…
item.description: The October 10, 2026 note about this change said the part of the east reach moved to P2 was about 3,800 square metres and that it included about 220 square metres overlapping P2. Measured again from the outlines before and after the change, the east reach lost about 3,740 square metres, and the two shapes had overlapped by about 1,220 square metres. The shape on the map is unchanged. Source: Pier & Point editorial review.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park, east reach: The record said this park stretch is on Mission…
item.description: The record said this park stretch is on Mission Creek's north/west bank; it is on the Channel St (south/east) bank. The map notes said OCII's map did not resolve P1 versus P3; the map's labels put P1 on this stretch and P3 east of 4th St, so the P-number and notes now say P1, and the 'complete' status is attributed to imagery, since the cited deck gives no status. The record's identifier, which still reads P1/P3, has not yet been renamed. The aerial photo credit no longer says it was taken from a departing flight. Source: OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, 2024-11-14 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).
